name: Gästehaus Obwexer
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Obwexer is located in Tirol, Österreich, and is run as an inn. The location is quiet and characterized by the rural surroundings of Tirol. Guests can expect a traditional atmosphere with down-to-earth service. The surroundings offer diverse opportunities for hiking and outdoor activities. The amenities include a restaurant and a lounge area. The rooms are simply and functionally furnished. Free Wi-Fi is available in the public areas.
